correctness.rationale: A nonalgebraic singleton determines an insertion gap and an independent neighborhood in the old graph. Any such ordered extension is triangle-free and realizable over the named copy; ultrahomogeneity gives one complete type per pattern. Thus the independent-set gap sum holds, and its diagonal is (n+1) times the independence polynomial. Independent replay with python3 /workspace/branches/2b23be7a-7a16-4309-a3f0-43fc241eba22/independent_check.py enumerates every triangle-free adjacency mask at orders 1–5 and compares permutation-canonical unordered graph codes within each exact coefficient fiber. The mask and fiber totals are (1,2,7,41,388) and (1,2,7,36,337), with one unordered isomorphism class in each fiber. This does not assert ordered reconstruction. On the six vertices, the checker reproduces the common polynomial and the opposite gap differences u^2v-uv^2 at gap 2 and its negative at gap 4 (independent_check_output.txt). The two connected six-edge graphs have unique cycles of length four and five, respectively. To verify the extension at all t, partition selected old neighbors by whether they meet W={3,4}. When they avoid W, the common induced complement and the common new order give termwise equality, including arbitrary choices among the appended twins. If they meet W, no twin can be selected: over the original gaps their summed difference equals the old total difference, which is zero. In the proof's per-gap wording at RESULT.md:44, it is the gap-specific old difference that remains at an individual gap; equality is required only after summation. At each extra gap the contributions use the old one-variable independence polynomial minus that of the common induced complement, hence agree. W is independent, both original graphs are connected, and the distinct old neighborhoods of 3 and 4 are disjoint in each. New four-cycles therefore cannot contain just one twin; those containing two twins are in bijection with twin pairs. This proves the exact four-cycle gap for arbitrary t, independently of the finite extension tests.

value.rationale: The invariant marks how a realizable neighborhood lies to either side of a new point in an ordered homogeneous structure; it is a natural positional refinement with more information than ordinary independent-set counts. The sharp first collision tests exactly how much of the underlying graph it can retain. The connected all-order construction avoids trivial padding by isolated components and proves a persistent failure to recover a basic cycle statistic. The benefit is the concrete reconstruction boundary and obstruction, not rederiving the type-to-independent-set formula.
